nom: Clinique All-in-One Cleansing Micellar Milk + Makeup Remover - Very Dry/Dry

segments.dry: Dry and very dry skin reviewers are the primary audience and mostly praise it for cleansing without stripping or tightening their skin, matching this Very Dry/Dry formula.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several, including some with rosacea, report burning, redness, or an allergic-type reaction, while many others say it's the gentlest cleanser they've found and never irritates their sensitive skin.
segments.oily: Oily and oily-combination reviewers mostly report it leaves their skin feeling oily or greasy afterward and doesn't suit their skin type, since the formula targets dry skin.
segments.normal: The few reviewers describing normal skin have mixed views, with one finding it leaves a greasy film while others with low-maintenance, non-sensitive skin like it as a gentle daily option.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report mixed results: some, especially those leaning dry, find it balances their skin without stripping it, while at least one with dry-but-oil-overproducing combination skin found it didn't work for her.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 60s, whose skin had become noticeably drier and more reactive with age, considers this cleansing milk essential to her routine.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, especially those with dry or very dry skin, say it leaves their skin soft, hydrated, and never stripped or tight, but a few describe the residue as sitting on top of the skin, feeling like it blocks their moisturizer rather than truly hydrating.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea are divided: some report burning and increased redness or an allergic-type reaction after using it, while other sensitive-skin reviewers, including one who specifically had a red face after cleansing before, report calmer, less red skin.
concerns.blemishes: The reviewers who mention acne or blemish-prone skin report positive results, including one whose hormonal acne cleared up and another whose perioral dermatitis stopped flaring after switching to this cleanser.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, particularly those with oily or combination skin, report the cleanser leaves an oily or greasy residue rather than a clean feeling, since the formula is designed for dry skin.

aspects.libelle: Rich, creamy texture favored by very dry skin
Doesn't foam or lather like a typical face wash
Thick formula is hard to dispense from the bottle, especially near the end
A lot of product gets wasted, stuck in the bottle
Doesn't fully remove heavy or waterproof makeup, especially mascara
Leaves skin feeling soft and not stripped

extraits.texte: Clinique has many great products, but this is not it. This product does not remove makeup let alone clean the skin. After messaging this product in and rinsing it off, there is still a lot of makeup left on my face. It leaves my skin feeling oily which is the exact opposite of how I want it to feel being that I have oily combo skin. This product just does not work. I will go back to using the take the day off balm, that I love, along with my cleanser. All in one sounded great but this product just did not deliver.

I loved the original Clinique Take the Day Off cleansing milk. Something in the new one w/ the Micellar Milk has caused an allergic reaction. I have not changed any other products. I have rosacea and I find my face is burning. :( I miss the old formula:(

extraits.titre: Sits on top of skin; Will be returning
extraits.texte: I purchased this after the Clinique Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk was discontinued, hoping it would be a suitable replacement. I've used it three times now, and I don't think there will be a fourth. The product is really thick and creamy, and spreads easily on skin, but does not lather, nor does it feel like it is actually sinking in and cleansing skin. It just sits on top of the skin. No matter how much I rinse/remove the cleanser, it still feels like it's sitting on top of my skin, and it seems to be blocking my moisturizer from sinking into my skin. It leaves my skin feeling almost suffocated, since it is so thick and never seems to come off. After using, my skin does not feel particularly cleansed, nor does it feel refreshed. Sadly disappointed with this product. The hunt for a new cleanser begins again!

extraits.titre: Creamy, soothing cleanser...Very Dry to Dry
extraits.texte: "All About Clean™ All-in-One Cleansing Micellar Milk + Makeup Remover" is the creamiest, most soothing cleanser for extra-dry skin...It is THE best!!! At 68, my skin has become decidedly dryer and more sensitive to EVERYTHING. Now I do wear waterproof mascara and must pre-treat the eyes with "Take the Day Off Cleansing Balm". Afterwards, I cleanse with the Micellar Milk cleanser followed by a through rinse and swipe with "Clarifying Lotion #1". As a final act, I apply "Moisture Surge Overnight Mask", "Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream" and then …I am ready for the night. This will be the first winter I get to use this cleanser, but I KNOW it will be extra helpful when dryness will be at its peak. Thank YOU, Clinique, for coming up with this delightful cream cleanser!!!

I have tried multiple different face cleansers and this one is the best I have used! I have bad hormonal acne and this has basically wiped my skin clean of any blemishes! It's a creamy base which makes my skin feel very soft and it feels very light. I actually use it in the shower even though it says to use it on a dry face. After using it I just rinse it off with some of the mild face soap. Fantastic cleanser would highly recommended and I want to buy 10 bottles of this to stock up.
By far my favorite cleanser for my extremely sensitive skin. No more red face after cleansing. Moisturizing and softening.
